Files such as `config/prod_secret.json`, `deploy/db-credentials.yaml` or `secret/x.txt` therefore pass both `sensitive()` and `pass2_credential()`, and are copied into `/source` in pass 2 (applied at line 179; the undecodable-name path at line 267 is affected too).
  WHY: `CLARIFY_SNAPSHOT_ALL_TEXT_ENABLED` defaults to `true` in all five caller workflows, so every clarify, plan, clarify-respond, triage and unblock-judge run shows these tracked files to the isolated agent and model, and the model's output is posted to issue comments. Before this PR they were outside the legacy roots and never reached the snapshot. The test fixture in tests/test_clarify_isolated_run.py:118-136 does not cover these patterns. All five reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high; there was no severity disagreement.

  WHY: Operators and readers of `agents.md` who rely on the docs will underestimate what reaches the isolated agent. The source rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high.
